narrator.instruct: Fast, dry, witty female narrator teasing a friend. Brisk, punchy, flowing delivery that runs sentences together with no pauses.

brooke.instruct: Bubbly, breathless young influencer filming herself, loud, squealing with excitement, very fast.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your Aquarius friend replied three days later, from a protest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That's Iris, brilliant, rebellious and slightly alien.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She brews her own kombucha in the bathtub.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She wears wool socks with sandals completely on purpose.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She loves humanity, but humans she's not so sure about.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her weird little band plays to five people in a laundromat.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nobody understands her and Iris is thrilled.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then an influencer walks in and starts filming.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: By morning, the video has a million views.

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: Socks with sandals are so in right now!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Suddenly the whole city dresses like Iris.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Iris looks at them. Then she looks at her socks.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So what's going on inside an Aquarius?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Picture a lab with a telescope pointed away from people.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A box labelled FEELINGS is locked. The key says LATER.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And one big switch marked IF POPULAR, STOP.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That switch just flipped.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Iris throws away her sandals and quits the band.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Back home the bathtub kombucha explodes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: By Friday she's into beekeeping and medieval choir music.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her five fans follow her. So does the influencer.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You text Iris. She replies from a beehive.
